stream_observation: one Bernoulli observation per evaluation stream per rollout
strict_group_policy: reject and count cells where observed streams != n_eval
duplicate_policy: accumulate repeated buffered levels; reject and count duplicate new groups
mixed_batch_policy: process existing level identities before any new-level eviction
checkpoint_policy: require saved PLR buffer and exact stored static PLR signature
xpid_policy: all PLR runs encode overlay version and contract hash
